summary: Validate rule transitions on empty blocks and recover paired MinerPass state before startup completes
details: Boundary and startup checks require explicit schema, state and energy transition policies across the indexed history. Existing pure conversions remain derivable from sparse checkpoints without changing persisted or commitment encodings.

Startup repairs energy publication tails and pending reorg recovery before exposing initialized state. A dataset without a committed first block uses the configured origin baseline; inconsistent energy progress is rejected before truncating committed records.

Isolated tests cover publication errors and process exits at the first block and two upgrade boundaries, cross-boundary reorg recovery, coherent checkpoint restore, and exact comparison with clean replay. Production remains schema v1, state machine v2 and energy v1; new fault injection and formulas exist only in test builds.
